description: This file provides extension methods for the AnyCodable type to facilitate conversion to standard Swift types such as String, Bool, Int, Double, Dictionary, and Array. It enhances the functionality of AnyCodable by offering convenient properties to access underlying values in different formats.

methods.name: stringValue
methods.description: Returns the value as an optional String if the underlying value is of type String.

methods.name: boolValue
methods.description: Returns the value as an optional Bool, handling NSNumber with boolean type.

methods.name: intValue
methods.description: Returns the value as an optional Int, converting from NSNumber if appropriate, considering only non-boolean NSNumber types.

methods.name: doubleValue
methods.description: Returns the value as an optional Double, converting from Int, NSNumber, or Double.

methods.name: dictionaryValue
methods.description: Returns the value as an optional dictionary [String: AnyCodable], converting from various dictionary representations.

methods.name: arrayValue
methods.description: Returns the value as an optional array of AnyCodable, converting from various array representations.

methods.name: foundationValue
methods.description: Converts the AnyCodable's underlying value into a Foundation-compatible type, recursively for dictionaries and arrays.
